newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Valspar rating raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Valspar rating raised.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Tuesday it raised its long-term rating on Valspar Corp to outperform from market perform. Its intermediate rating remains outperform.
-- EVEREN also raised its fiscal 1997 earnings per share estimate for Valspar to $2.95 from $2.85, and established a fiscal 1998 estimate of $3.35.
-- On November 18, Valspar reported fourth quarter 1996 earnings of $0.78 a share, more than EVEREN's $0.76 estimate and up from $0.66 a year ago.

-- EVEREN said its earnings estimates reflected an estimated 12 percent rise in sales in fiscal 1997, with no future acquisitions. However, additive acquisitions were likely to be made by the company, the firm said.
-- The price target was raised to $60 a share from $50 in the intermediate term, and to $68 a share from $55 for the long term.
-- Shares of Valspar, which makes paints and industrial coatings, were up 2-3/4 at 53-3/4 at 1515 EST/2000 GMT on the New York Stock Exchange.
